mapper.insert: insert into courses(title, type, duration_minutes, level, equipment, summary, cover_image, video_url, video_cover_image, video_duration_seconds, status, sort_order) values (trim(#{request.title}), trim(#{request.type}), #{request.durationMinutes}, trim(#{request.level}), trim(#{request.equipment}), trim(#{request.summary}), nullif(trim(#{request.coverImage}), ''), nullif(trim(#{request.videoUrl}), ''), nullif(trim(#{request.videoCoverImage}), ''), #{request.videoDurationSeconds}, #{request.status}, #{request.sortOrder})
mapper.update: update courses set title = trim(#{request.title}), type = trim(#{request.type}), duration_minutes = #{request.durationMinutes}, level = trim(#{request.level}), equipment = trim(#{request.equipment}), summary = trim(#{request.summary}), cover_image = nullif(trim(#{request.coverImage}), ''), video_url = nullif(trim(#{request.videoUrl}), ''), video_cover_image = nullif(trim(#{request.videoCoverImage}), ''), video_duration_seconds = #{request.videoDurationSeconds}, status = #{request.status}, sort_order = #{request.sortOrder} where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into course_exercises(course_id, exercise_id, sort_order) values (#{courseId}, #{exerciseId}, #{sortOrder})

mapper.select: select count(*) from training_plans lower(title) like concat('%', lower(#{query}), '%')

select * from training_plans where id = #{id}

select i.id, i.course_id, c.title course_title, i.day_offset, i.sort_order from training_plan_items i join courses c on c.id = i.course_id where i.plan_id = #{planId} order by i.day_offset, i.sort_order
mapper.insert: insert into training_plans(title, week_number, sessions_per_week, description, active, sort_order) values (trim(#{request.title}), #{request.weekNumber}, #{request.sessionsPerWeek}, nullif(trim(#{request.description}), ''), #{request.active}, #{request.sortOrder})
insert into training_plan_items(plan_id, course_id, day_offset, sort_order) values (#{planId}, #{item.courseId}, #{item.dayOffset}, #{item.sortOrder})

select count(*) from user_feedback status = #{status}

mapper.select: select c.*, count(d.id) device_count from device_categories c left join devices d on d.category = c.name group by c.id, c.name, c.device_model, c.sn_prefix, c.sort_order, c.created_at, c.updated_at order by c.sort_order, c.id

select c.*, count(d.id) device_count from device_categories c left join devices d on d.category = c.name where c.id = #{id} group by c.id, c.name, c.device_model, c.sn_prefix, c.sort_order, c.created_at, c.updated_at

select c.*, count(d.id) device_count from device_categories c left join devices d on d.category = c.name where c.name = #{name} group by c.id, c.name, c.device_model, c.sn_prefix, c.sort_order, c.created_at, c.updated_at
mapper.insert: insert into device_categories(name, device_model, sn_prefix, sort_order) values (trim(#{request.name}), trim(#{request.deviceModel}), upper(trim(#{request.snPrefix})), #{request.sortOrder})
mapper.select: select d.*, count(uds.user_id) bound_user_count from devices d left join user_device_selections uds on uds.device_id = d.id where d.id = #{id} group by d.id, d.code, d.name, d.category, d.serial_number, d.device_model, d.bed_type, d.spring_config, d.purchased_on, d.connected, d.active, d.sort_order, d.created_at, d.updated_at
mapper.insert: insert into devices(code, name, category, serial_number, qr_token, device_model, bed_type, spring_config, purchased_on, connected, active, sort_order) values (upper(replace(replace(trim(#{request.code}), '-', '_'), ' ', '_')), trim(#{request.name}), trim(#{request.category}), upper(trim(#{request.serialNumber})), #{request.qrToken}, trim(#{request.deviceModel}), trim(#{request.bedType}), trim(#{request.springConfig}), #{request.purchasedOn}, #{request.connected}, #{request.active}, #{request.sortOrder})
mapper.select: select qr_token from devices where id = #{id}
